concepts.label: Restoration date
concepts.note: When the restoration the source describes actually happened. This is the field that controls scoring.

concepts.label: Source publication date
concepts.note: Not recorded for any recovery source in this corpus: every one carries a URL and nothing else, and none of them appears as a dated incident source. It is left null rather than inferred from a retrieval time, a URL fragment or a commit date — none of which is a publication date.

concepts.label: First present in dashboard
concepts.note: Available only from the build ledger, and only when its lineage is provable. It is NOT when the report was published or when anyone learned of it — the report may have existed long before this dataset ingested it.

temporal_model.warning: These four are different questions. A lifecycle that averaged them would produce a number describing nothing.

reconstruction_caveat: Historical trajectories are reconstructed using the current evidence set. Later evidence may refine the modelled trajectory before the restoration date. This is not an archive of what was known at the time.

layer_labels.model: Modelled disruption weight — the value feeding the index, not measured repair progress

stage_meaning.flow_rerouting: Throughput was routed around the damage. The damaged asset itself is NOT repaired, and this stage says nothing about its condition.
stage_meaning.partial_operations_resumed: Some operations resumed. The facility is not fully restored.
stage_meaning.service_restoration: The service the facility provides was restored. This does not establish that the facility was rebuilt.
stage_meaning.unit_restart: A specific unit restarted. Other units may remain down.
stage_meaning.physical_reconstitution: The physical asset was rebuilt or replaced.
stage_meaning.estimated_restoration: No restoration was observed. This is a modelled or estimated horizon, not a report.

milestones.what_source_establishes: After the 20 Aug 2026 strike on the 500 kV Taman substation (through which all four Kerch energy-bridge lines pass), the Russian-installed head of Sevastopol said power restrictions in the affected Crimean cities were lifted after ~90 minutes but the grid remained unstable. This is emergency-switching restoration of supply, NOT confirmed repair of the damaged substation; renewed Crimea outages the next night are consistent with the hub not being reconstituted. observed_days left blank: the node itself was not restored.

By ~11 Nov 2025 daily processing reached ~27,000 t/day, matching all three units -- full restoration of the damaged units, not merely rerouted loadings.
